weapons.title: Приказ: Сплошной Огонь
weapons.silhouette: spectral rifle rank behind a raised war banner
weapons.motion_path: three aimed volleys sweeping one straight arena-crossing lane
weapons.impact_language: three muzzle-flash waves that break on the first dense group, then a smoke recall

performance.v2_presence_note: FAN-3941: the authored formation plus the backdrop veil and hero cast pose; the veil is a gradient sprite with no material

quality.reduced_motion_substitute: with ultimate_reduced_motion on (the persisted ultimate_accessibility_settings preference, read by the scene driver itself; the shipped screen_shake toggle also holds it) the scene driver applies no camera shake, so the authored AnimationPlayer timeline's war banner, spectral rifle rank, volley lane and three muzzle-flash waves carry the beat as alpha steps and the rank's aim rotation on the unchanged timing; the backdrop veil still darkens to 0.30 and the first-impact hitstop still pauses the authored timeline
quality.measurement: FAN-3941 real-runtime certification capture: peak authored-scene opaque coverage 0.0300 of the viewport (alpha >= 0.5 on a paused scene-only render of the live cast started through UltimatePlayerHost, stride 2; the 1152x648 normal cast is swept every frame at 60 fixed fps and every committed frame is measured); the arena-wide veil is a translucent darken tint peaking at 0.30 that rises once per cast and is excluded from opaque coverage; it is layered at absolute z 2, above the arena floor and the actors but below every enemy hazard telegraph (z 6-9) and enemy projectile (z 12), so telegraphs and bolts keep their native contrast under it; with ultimate_photosensitivity_safe on the driver never lights it; the live cast moves the Player camera on the first impact with the preferences off and 0 px with ultimate_reduced_motion on (per-frame traces in the capture manifest)

live_capture.note: Real-runtime four-mode frames per weapon and viewport through UltimatePlayerHost with the shipped Player, real Enemy scenes, a real hazard telegraph and enemy projectile and the live ultimate HUD adapter under a fixed 60 fps clock: the active beat and, for soldier_grenade, the executor-clock detonation/crater/final beats at every viewport, plus release/impact/recovery at 1152x648. `crowded` stands the declared crowd cap; `reduced_motion` applies the shipped screen_shake toggle (an intrinsic no-op for the Soldier scenes, measured as a zero camera trace); `photosensitivity_safe` additionally has no full-screen surface to suppress (measured zero). The four legacy resolution sheets above remain the FAN-1468 contact sheets.

certification.note: Real-runtime captures: one cast per weapon x mode x viewport through UltimatePlayerHost with the shipped Player (own current Camera2D), real Enemy scenes, a real hazard telegraph and enemy projectile, and the live ultimate HUD adapter, under a fixed 60 fps clock and the exclusive process admission, with the reduced-motion and photosensitivity-safe modes published through the production ultimate_accessibility_settings snapshot; the active beat and every payoff beat at every viewport plus release/impact/recovery at 1152x648. The capture manifest pins every file hash, the engine, the command, per-frame camera/world state, the measured coverage and the per-run camera-offset traces behind the mode effects.
